# Cncf Torchx Reviewer

Review Torchx using its official documentation and repository in the Training / Distributed Training category. Universal job launcher for PyTorch applications. TorchX is designed to have fast iteration time for training/research and support for E2E production ML pipelines when you&#39;re ready.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
